author: Michael Larabel
description: With age verification/attestation laws down to the OS level enacted by California and being decided upon by other US states, it's been a hot topic of discussion in the open-source world. For the Debian project that is strictly volunteer/community-driven unlike various commercial Linux platforms, they are figuring out how such laws will impact them...
title: Debian Is Figuring Out How Age Verification Laws Will Impact It

author: Michael Larabel
description: Ahead of tomorrow's Linux 7.0-rc7 kernel release, this week's batch of input fixes were sent in and merged. Besides a few small input fixes are also some new device IDs and quirks for hardware now to be handled by Linux 7.0...
title: Razer Wolverine V3 Pro & Betop KP50 Controllers To Be Supported By Linux 7.0

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to 3mdeb firmware engineers porting AMD openSIL and Coreboot to a Gigabyte EPYC Turin server motherboard, the staff at this firmware consulting company are also porting AMD openSIL and Coreboot to a modern Ryzen AM5 desktop motherboard. They continue making good strides with that quest for the first readily-available Ryzen desktop motherboard with open-source system firmware...
title: 3mdeb Makes Progress Bringing AMD openSIL + Coreboot To Ryzen AM5 Motherboard

author: Michael Larabel
description: In the past few days was the release of FreeCAD 1.1 and SolveSpace 3.2 for open-source computer aided design (CAD) while now joining the party is Design 50 Alpha as a GNOME-aligned 2D CAD design tool...
title: 2D CAD Design Tool For GNOME Desktop Lands More Features

author: Michael Larabel
description: KDE Plasma developers continue working on new features for Plasma 6.7 while continuing to land more fixes and hardening for the current Plasma 6.6 stable series...
title: KDE's KWin Continues Working On Vulkan Support, Other Improvements For Plasma 6.7
